name: Saint Leo the Great
history: Pope at a time of collapse, Leo defined the Church's faith that Christ is one Person in two natures, a teaching the Council of Chalcedon received with the cry 'Peter has spoken through Leo'. He met Attila the Hun outside Rome and persuaded him to turn back.
meditation: Christian, remember your dignity. What would change if you believed it today?
life: Leo was a deacon of the Roman Church, trusted with delicate missions, and was away in Gaul when he was elected pope in 440. In 449 he sent his Tome to Bishop Flavian of Constantinople, setting out the faith that the one Christ is truly God and truly man, without confusion and without division. When a council at Ephesus that year rejected it by violence, Leo called it a robbery; two years later the Council of Chalcedon received his teaching. In 452 he went out to meet Attila near Mantua and the Huns withdrew from Italy. In 455 he could not prevent the Vandals from sacking Rome, but he persuaded their king to spare the city from burning and slaughter. Nearly a hundred of his sermons survive, clear and dignified. He died in 461 and was named a Doctor of the Church in 1754.
prayerTo: Saint Leo, faithful successor of Peter, you taught the Church to confess Christ as true God and true man, and you stood before invaders for your people. Pray that I may hold the faith clearly and humbly, remember the dignity God has given me, and not lose courage when the world around me is shaken. Amen.
penance: Read slowly the Church's confession of Christ in the Creed, and pray it for those who have lost their faith. Leo urged fasting joined to almsgiving: give the price of a meal to the poor.
